fuzz {
switch n {
case Foo/A:
  ()
case Voluntary<Int>.Naught,
     Voluntary<Int>.Naught(),
     Voluntary<Int>. Naught(_, _),
     Voluntary.Naught,
     .Naught: // c

  ()
case Voluntary<Int>.Mere,
     Voluntary<Int>.Mere(_),
     Voluntary<Int>.Mere(_, _),
     Voluntary.Mere,
     Voluntary.Mere(_),
     .Mere,
     .Mere(_):
  ()
case .Twain,
     .Twain(_),
     .Twain(_, _),
     .Twain(_, _, _):
  ()
}
}
